description: 0.3% fee plus the reserve shift on a shallow pool (naive ratio would say 100)
the lesson's worked example: 10k into a balanced 1M/1M pool at 0.3%
empty reserve_in: without the guard the denominator collapses to amount_in_with_fee and the quote hands back the whole of reserve_out
u64::MAX everywhere: the numerator runs past u128, so the CHECKED multiply must degrade to 0 — a bare u128 `*` panics here
1e18 reserves, 1e12 in: comfortably inside u128 but far past a u64 multiply, so this is the case that forces the promotion
